steps.title: Take command
steps.teach: Click a squad to select it. Drag a box to select several. The panel on the right reads whatever you have selected.
steps.nudge: Click the squad on the left of the field.

steps.title: Move by bounds
steps.teach: Right-click ground to send them. Hold shift to queue a route around cover instead of straight across open ground. Press h to stop them where they stand.
steps.nudge: Right-click the marked ground to the east.

steps.title: Cover is terrain, not a stance
steps.teach: The rocky ground ahead is heavy cover, and standing in it beats any order you can give. Press o for the roll feed: every shot lists its factors, and cov is the ground working for you.
steps.nudge: Move into the rocks, then press o. The feed fills once rounds start landing.

steps.title: Fire pins. It rarely kills.
steps.teach: Hold in the rocks and a second squad comes up behind you. Keep one squad firing into the enclosure and bring the APC's gun to bear; a pinned enemy cannot shoot back while the rounds keep landing.
steps.nudge: Keep one squad firing. Suppression lasts only while fire lands.

steps.title: Get inside
steps.teach: Right-click a building with infantry selected and they occupy it. Walls beat any amount of manoeuvre when you need to hold ground.
steps.nudge: Select infantry and right-click the house.

steps.title: Reach and patience
steps.teach: A sniper team has joined you. It outranges everything on foot and earns intel while it sits still. Put it on the grove and let it work.
steps.nudge: Move the sniper team into the olive grove and leave it stationary.

steps.title: Mount up
steps.teach: Push east and transports report in on the road. Select a carrier and the infantry, press g to load and u to dismount, then drive to the road's west end -- a freed seat gets filled again on the spot.
steps.nudge: Head east for the transports, then select the APC and a squad, press g, drive west and press u.

steps.title: Armour has a back
steps.teach: Reach the road's west end and the Lavi and AT team report in. The Lavi has 700mm at the front, 150 at the rear -- where it points decides whether a hit matters. Press f to lay smoke.
steps.nudge: Drive the column to the road's west end for the Lavi, then select it and press f, keeping its front toward the threat.

steps.title: And armour dies
steps.teach: The AT team's missile ignores most of what makes a tank a tank. Everything on this field can be killed by the right thing; the game is bringing it.
steps.nudge: Put the AT team on the technical at the east end of the road.

steps.title: Eyes before guns
steps.teach: Reach the road's east end and the drones report in. The recon drone sees without being shot at, and what it identifies your guns can engage. The attack drone is one-use: ordnance, not a scout.
steps.nudge: Get to the road's east end for the drones, then send the attack drone at the RPG team.

steps.title: What a shot costs
steps.teach: Swing south past the shed and a mortar team and demo squad come up. The mortar does not care what is under it -- the flagged house has people in it, and the score you carry forward remembers. The shed is fair game.
steps.nudge: Push south for the mortar, then try it near the flagged house and watch the ROE reading move.

steps.title: Command groups
steps.teach: Ctrl and a number binds the selection to that key; the number alone recalls it; twice centres the camera on it. Twelve units are unmanageable without this.
steps.nudge: Select some units and press ctrl+1.
